requirements: Boombox is the universal challenge initializer and mob-head/emblem gang selector.
Gang music uses replaceable valid silent placeholders until owner-authored tracks are supplied.
Vanilla and modded mobs are never replaced; Gang Skates attach reversible JetSetCraft state to original entities.
Approved gang names are canonical defaults stored as data and remain easy to change.
Friendly reputation unlocks safe in-game gang renaming while stable gang IDs preserve progression.
Players may eventually join and max reputation with all gangs while betrayal and reconciliation remain possible.
The Atlas covers all vanilla mobs, valid baby/junior mobs with cute pun subcrew names and music profiles, and mobs detected from installed mods.
Gang minigames include Turf War, graffiti, trick battles, racing, Tag, dance battles, and spray-paint combat with high-quality AI.
Natural gang encounters remain ultra rare while the Boombox provides deliberate replayable challenges.
publication_targets: GitHub Wiki through the validated wiki sync workflow
